tool_args.rationale: The paid pilot observations exhibit the specified high-frequency sign-oscillation signature, so a stationary quantitative law cannot be justified for fresh forecasts.

considered_alternatives.option: Stationary Vogel-Fulcher, stretched-exponential, and power-law models
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The observed high-frequency sign-oscillation signature indicates non-stationary behavior outside these smooth mechanisms.
The supplied signature already triggers scoped abstention; further measurements are not needed for this decision.
